role: Static English help content for five categories (AI Assistant, Get Me Back, Your Data, Personalization, App Navigation) as HelpCategory/HelpArticle/ArticleSection literals; HelpContent.categories(forAge:) localizes them via HelpLocalization at hand-out.
types: extension HelpContent — static categories aiAssistant, getMeBack, yourData, personalization, appNavigation
toplevel: All content is stored-property initializers: user-facing claims about the app, including numeric facts (25 remembered facts, 8 tool calls per question, 4,096-token Apple context trimmed at 70%, 600 ms/300 ms/2-word voice interrupt gates, 25 m/60 s address refresh and 5-minute freshness, GPS arrow tiers 10/30/100 m, 50 archived trails, 90-day Trash, 5-attempt strap retry, 10/30-minute sync throttle, 14 system tags, 12 custom-tag colors, 60 RR minimum and 300–2000 ms import bounds, 17 languages, 6 themes, 30-day trial, 14 nights before a score, score bands 90/75/60/45/30, 60-day baseline, 60/25/15 and 70/30 weights, 10-session pagination, 5.5 breaths/min) and AI model names per provider. The Device Has Stored Data article names the card's "Delete from [Device Name]" button (with its confirmation and the only-copy warning), and the iCloud Sync article says sync stays with the iCloud account it was turned on for and turns itself off for another account or deleted iCloud data. Spot checks: maxFacts = 25 (Assistant/Chat/UserFactsStore.swift), maxToolCallsPerTurn = 8 (Assistant/ViewModel/AssistantViewModel+Tools.swift), trial durationDays = 30 (Services/EntitlementAnchor.swift), model display names match the provider files (e.g. OpenAIProvider.swift 'GPT-6 Luna', GeminiProvider.swift '3.8 Flash'), Settings → Biometrics has homeAddressSection (BiometricsSettingsPage+Sections.swift). Other numbers were not verified in this chunk. appNavigation lacks the @MainActor annotation the other four carry, but the enclosing enum is @MainActor so isolation is the same.
